title: Fix test_edit_token_after_advanced_api_detail_reopens_detail_draft_and_preserves_api_access and related wizard flow tests
goal: For each affected test, before clicking [data-wizard-create-mission], add a check for wizard-roe-authorization-checkbox and check it if present and unchecked. This is the same pattern as backlog-142 but applied to tests that directly call the button rather than using the helper.
scope: Multiple wizard flow tests fail with disabled Create Mission button (same root cause as backlog-142). These tests are identified separately because they test specific advanced wizard flows: test_edit_token_after_advanced_api_detail_reopens_detail_draft_and_preserves_api_access, test_clearing_advanced_scope_from_confirmation_returns_to_scope_with_visible_validation_feedback, test_authenticated_only_advanced_profile_from_confirmation_reopens_access_before_confirm. These tests likely also call _launch_guided_mission_from_preview or directly call [data-wizard-create-mission] without first checking/clicking wizard-roe-authorization-checkbox.
